verified_findings.finding: Both retained final errors are subprocess.TimeoutExpired for exact ps -axo pid=,ppid=,pgid=,lstart=,command= after15s. This is an ownership-observation failure, not an XCTest assertion or application crash.

Canonical and companion owned_lane.snapshot_processes are byte-identical. Each register/refresh/signal-owned uses this global ps command. Both command loops refresh then sleep0.25s; the 15s subprocess budget is distinct from xcodebuild2700s. The unchanged archived DarwinBackend is only called during the later normal external-image observation, which was never reached.

A raw xcodebuild output reached initial build graph/clang/swift version and actool asset metadata preparation, ending BUILD INTERRUPTED. No Kotlin phase, application installation, XCTest, Foundation row or functional receipt is present. B compressed raw xcodebuild output decompresses to empty bytes and its retained uncompressed hash is SHA256(empty); exit -15 reflects owned failure cleanup, not an independently observed app crash.

Neither final ownership ledger contains a Gradle build daemon/wrapper invocation. A immediate stop downloaded the Gradle8.13 distribution and reported no daemons. B stop likewise reported no daemons. Both configured -Xmx6g, but a launched build JVM is not evidenced before this failure, so blaming its heap for this incident is unsupported.

A command row has neither exit_code nor interrupted_or_failed. Source catches BaseException, calls owner.stop, then writes those fields; a fallible stop/ps observation can raise before that assignment and replace the original exception. A owned XcodePID4588 subsequently spawned recorded Xcode/SwiftBuild/actool descendants during later finalization. Final owned stop and cleanup passed, but this missing-field receipt does not identify the first failing call site or prove immediate command retirement.

Both canonical final cleanup receipts and outer uploaded-custody cleanup pass; owned devices absent, task workers/unknown holders empty, exact temporary allocations removed, source/controls unchanged. This is cleanup evidence only, not runtime success.
